description: An object constructor whose key template fails takes no part in unifying when it isn't selected
notes: The spec says errors in the result that isn't selected aren't passed through, and that both results must unify, but not what type a failed result has. hashicorp/hcl evaluates both results (ConditionalExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go), and ObjectConsExpr.Value gives the dynamic value when a key fails, even one whose template still gives a string. Because one result has the dynamic pseudo-type, it skips unification and returns the selected result unconverted.
